---
title: "Matched community structure across 16S, MG and MT"
format: html
editor: source
execute:
  enabled: false
---

Run `bash scripts/run_qmd.sh analysis/community_cross_omics.qmd NEW_OUTPUT`.
This descriptive comparison uses all 12 matched samples, without rerunning the
collaborator's 16S pipeline. MG denotes the fraction of reads assigned to each
MAG; MT denotes the fraction of gene-assigned reads contributed by each MAG.
Neither quantity is an absolute cell abundance or a per-cell transcription rate.
16S uses the unrarefied ASV profile. Each assay is normalised separately.
Bray–Curtis distances between samples can be compared without assuming that
SILVA and GTDB labels are interchangeable. Correlations of distance matrices are
descriptive; their 66 entries are not independent replicates. No p values are
calculated. Taxonomic profiles retain their original assignments, including
unassigned categories. MT counts are aggregated before any DE gene filtering.

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(data.table); library(digest)})
out <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)[1]
stopifnot(!dir.exists(out))
root <- "/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569"
ret <- file.path(root,"incoming/16s_collaborator_return_2026-09-07/extracted/derived/16s_analysis/05_phyloseq")
paths <- c(MG=file.path(root,"derived/community_cycle_models_2026-09-13-v1/tables/mag_counts.tsv"),
 MT=file.path(root,"derived/full_transcriptome_de/tables/collapsed_raw_count_matrix.tsv"),
 ASV=file.path(ret,"16s_asv_counts_unrarefied.tsv"),
 taxonomy16S=file.path(ret,"16s_asv_taxonomy_silva138.2.tsv"),
 taxonomyMAG=file.path(root,"derived/manuscript_figure_candidates/tables/mag_taxonomic_context.tsv"),
 metadata=file.path(getwd(),"metadata/sample_metadata.tsv"))
stopifnot(all(file.exists(paths)))
dir.create(out,recursive=TRUE)
write <- function(x,n) fwrite(x,file.path(out,paste0(n,".tsv")),sep="\t")
write(data.table(source=names(paths),path=paths,sha256=vapply(paths,function(p)digest(file=p,algo="sha256"),character(1))),"input_sha256")
meta <- fread(paths['metadata'])[,.(sample_title,condition,phase,cycle)]
setorder(meta,condition,phase,cycle)
s <- meta$sample_title
stopifnot(length(s)==12,!anyDuplicated(s),all(table(meta$condition,meta$phase,meta$cycle)==1))
mg <- fread(paths['MG']); setnames(mg,"feature_id","MAG_ID")
mt <- fread(paths['MT'])
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(mt$feature_id),all(mt$gene_length>0))
mt <- mt[,lapply(.SD,sum),by=MAG_ID,.SDcols=s]
write(data.table(sample_title=s,all_gene_assigned_reads=colSums(mt[,..s]),MAG_assigned_reads=colSums(mt[!is.na(MAG_ID) & MAG_ID!="",..s])),"MT_MAG_assignment_coverage")
mt <- mt[!is.na(MAG_ID) & MAG_ID!=""]
asv <- fread(paths['ASV'])
tax <- fread(paths['taxonomyMAG'],select=c("MAG_ID","domain","phylum","class","order","family","genus","species"))
tx16 <- fread(paths['taxonomy16S'])
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(tax$MAG_ID),!anyDuplicated(tx16$asv_id),
 setequal(mg$MAG_ID,mt$MAG_ID),setequal(mg$MAG_ID,tax$MAG_ID),setequal(asv$asv_id,tx16$asv_id))
matrix_of <- function(x,id){
 stopifnot(all(s %in% names(x)),!anyDuplicated(x[[id]]))
 m <- as.matrix(x[,..s]); rownames(m)<-x[[id]]
 stopifnot(all(is.finite(m)),all(m>=0),all(colSums(m)>0))
 sweep(m,2,colSums(m),"/")
}
profiles <- list(MG=matrix_of(mg,"MAG_ID"),MT=matrix_of(mt,"MAG_ID"),`16S`=matrix_of(asv,"asv_id"))
stopifnot(all(vapply(profiles,function(x)max(abs(colSums(x)-1))<1e-12,logical(1))))
bray <- function(m) {
 d<-matrix(0,ncol(m),ncol(m),dimnames=list(colnames(m),colnames(m)))
 for(i in seq_len(ncol(m)))for(j in seq_len(ncol(m)))d[i,j]<-sum(abs(m[,i]-m[,j]))/sum(m[,i]+m[,j])
 d
}
distances<-lapply(profiles,bray)
pairs<-combn(names(profiles),2,simplify=FALSE)
write(rbindlist(lapply(pairs,function(p)data.table(assay1=p[1],assay2=p[2],n_pairs=66,
 spearman=cor(distances[[p[1]]][lower.tri(distances[[p[1]]])],distances[[p[2]]][lower.tri(distances[[p[2]]])],method="spearman")))),"distance_concordance")
turn_rows<-list()
for(a in names(profiles)) for(co in unique(meta$condition)) for(ph in unique(meta$phase)) for(cy in 1:2){
 x<-meta[condition==co & phase==ph & cycle==cy,sample_title];y<-meta[condition==co & phase==ph & cycle==cy+1,sample_title]
 turn_rows[[length(turn_rows)+1L]]<-data.table(assay=a,condition=co,phase=ph,transition=paste(cy,cy+1,sep="-"),bray=distances[[a]][x,y])
}
turn<-rbindlist(turn_rows)
write(turn,"cycle_turnover")
for(a in names(profiles)){
 m<-profiles[[a]];write(data.table(feature_id=rownames(m),m),paste0(a,"_relative_profile"))
 tx<-if(a=="16S")copy(tx16) else copy(tax)
 id<-if(a=="16S")"asv_id" else "MAG_ID"
 ranks<-if(a=="16S")c("Phylum","Family","Genus") else c("phylum","family","genus","species")
 tx<-tx[match(rownames(m),tx[[id]])]
 for(rank in ranks){
  labels<-tx[[rank]]; labels[is.na(labels)|labels==""]<-"Unassigned"
  tab<-rowsum(m,labels); z<-data.table(taxon=rownames(tab),mean_percent=100*rowMeans(tab),100*tab)
  setorder(z,-mean_percent);write(z,paste(a,rank,"profile",sep="_"))
 }
}
mm<-profiles$MT[rownames(profiles$MG),,drop=FALSE]
write(data.table(sample_title=s,spearman=vapply(seq_along(s),function(i)cor(profiles$MG[,i],mm[,i],method="spearman"),numeric(1))),"MG_MT_matched_rank_correlation")
mag<-merge(tax,data.table(MAG_ID=rownames(profiles$MG),MG_mean_percent=100*rowMeans(profiles$MG),MT_mean_percent=100*rowMeans(mm)),by="MAG_ID")
mag[,MT_to_MG_read_share:=MT_mean_percent/MG_mean_percent]
setorder(mag,-MT_mean_percent);write(mag,"MAG_contributions")
write(data.table(rank=c("genus","species"),unassigned_MAGs=c(sum(is.na(tax$genus)|tax$genus==""),sum(is.na(tax$species)|tax$species==""))),"MAG_assignment")
write(meta,"matched_samples")
write(data.table(check=c("matched_samples","MG_features","MT_features","16S_features","relative_profiles_sum_to_one"),value=c(length(s),nrow(mg),nrow(mt),nrow(asv),1)),"checks")
capture.output(sessionInfo(),file=file.path(out,"sessionInfo.txt"))
print(fread(file.path(out,"distance_concordance.tsv")))
print(turn)
print(mag[1:10])
```
